query:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM run_queue o
                    WHERE o.released_at IS NULL
                      AND (o.priority, o.queued_at, o.id) <= (q.priority, q.queued_at, q.id))
                  AS "position!"
             FROM run_queue q
            WHERE q.released_at IS NULL
              AND (q.build_id = $1 OR q.grading_run_id = $2)
